sn52.1:6.1: If they wish: ‘May I meditate perceiving the repulsive in the unrepulsive,’ that’s what they do.
sn52.1:6.2: If they wish: ‘May I meditate perceiving the unrepulsive in the repulsive,’ that’s what they do.
sn52.1:6.3: If they wish: ‘May I meditate perceiving the repulsive in the unrepulsive and the repulsive,’ that’s what they do.
sn52.1:6.4: If they wish: ‘May I meditate perceiving the unrepulsive in the repulsive and the unrepulsive,’ that’s what they do.
sn52.1:6.5: If they wish: ‘May I meditate staying equanimous, mindful and aware, shunning both the repulsive and the unrepulsive,’ that’s what they do.
sn52.1:8.1: If they wish: ‘May I meditate perceiving the repulsive in the unrepulsive,’ that’s what they do. …
sn52.1:8.2: If they wish: ‘May I meditate staying equanimous, mindful and aware, ignoring both the repulsive and the unrepulsive,’ that’s what they do.
